documents.text: RMS Adriatic (1906) RMS "Adriatic" was an ocean liner of the White Star Line. She was the fourth of a quartet of ships measuring over 20,000 tons, dubbed The Big Four. The ship was the only one of the four which was never the world's largest ship; however, she was the fastest of the Big Four. "Adriatic" was the first ocean liner to have an indoor swimming pool and a Turkish bath. She was built by Harland and Wolff and was launched on 20 September 1906 (the same day as the Cunard Line's ).
